meta.name: understand-dashboard
meta.description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 可视化代码库知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要直观浏览代码库的结构和依赖关系。
copy.tagline_en: Visualize your codebase's knowledge graph interactively.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore your codebase's structure and dependencies visually.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会启动一个网页仪表盘，用图形展示当前项目的知识图谱。
howto.when: 当你要求查看项目的知识图谱或代码结构时触发。

say.text: 启动仪表盘，显示当前项目的知识图谱。
say.note: Claude 会启动一个网页，展示代码关系图。

say.text: 帮我打开知识图谱仪表盘。
say.note: Claude 会启动仪表盘并返回访问链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude launches a web dashboard that visualizes the knowledge graph of the current project as an interactive graph.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to view the project's knowledge graph or code structure.

say_en.text: Launch the dashboard to show the knowledge graph of the current project.
say_en.note: Claude will start a web page displaying code relationships.

say_en.text: Open the knowledge graph dashboard for me.
say_en.note: Claude will start the dashboard and return the access link.
